left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Adult patients over 18 years
  -  Diagnosis of Pulmonary arterial hypertension  [OR] or non-operable chronic thromboembolic pulmonary hypertension established by right cardiac catheterization prior to inclusion in the study
  -  Patients admitted in intensive care unit for acute decompensation of pulmonary hypertension requiring intravenous diuretic therapy  [OR] ± use of inotropes  [OR] or vasopressors

right.raw_text:
-  Patients must have given their written informed consent to participate in the study after having received adequate previous information and prior to any study-specific procedures
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Patients with post-capillary pulmonary hypertension
  -  Patients with pulmonary hypertension associated with chronic respiratory disease
  -  Patients with pulmonary hypertension with unclear/ [OR] or multifactorial mechanisms
  -  Patients with operable chronic thromboembolic pulmonary hypertension
  -  Shock due to another cause than acute decompensation of pulmonary hypertension
  -  Pregnant women, [OR]  or breast feeding women
  -  Adult protected person
  -  Person deprived of liberty
  -  Person admitted without consent
  -  Pregnant  [OR] or breastfeeding women
